stem:
Rohit labels three motions on a classroom chart: Earth spinning once a day, Earth going around the Sun once a year, and the Moon going around Earth. The chart also shows an artificial spacecraft orbiting Earth.

Which row names the motions correctly?

options.text: Rotation; revolution; satellite motion around Earth
Revolution; rotation; satellite motion around Earth
Rotation; revolution; the Moon revolves around the Sun instead of around Earth
Rotation; revolution; an artificial spacecraft orbiting Earth is not a satellite

teacher.key_rationale: Spinning about an axis is rotation; going around the Sun is revolution; the Moon moving around Earth is satellite motion. Swapping rotation and revolution, sending the Moon around the Sun, or denying that an orbiting craft is a satellite are wrong.
